metadata.name: Audit Evidence
metadata.description: Evidence-first output for Checker reports, governance decisions and trail reviews.

styleRules: Map each acceptance criterion to its actual evidence.
Preserve NOT-RUN, NOT-YET-VERIFIED and CONFIRMED as distinct states.
State missing, conflicting or insufficient evidence explicitly.
Never convert a tool response or agent assertion into proof without verification.

hostProjectionHints.claude-code: Generate a selectable output-style projection when supported.
hostProjectionHints.vscode: Inject this profile through the host adapter as presentation context.
hostProjectionHints.cursor: Project as agent or rule presentation instructions.
hostProjectionHints.codex: Project as scoped instructions; do not assume a native output-style selector.
